description: This file defines the GammaDistribution class, which implements the Gamma probability distribution. It includes parameters such as shape and scale, density and logDensity calculations, probability computations, and sampling methods specific to the Gamma distribution.

classes.name: GammaDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the gamma probability distribution with methods for density calculation, cumulative probability, and random sampling.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function (PDF) at a given value x, using natural computation or overflow-safe approximation.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density function at a given value x, with overflow handling.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative probability up to x, using the regularized gamma function.

methods.name: getShape
methods.description: Returns the shape parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the scale parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the Gamma distribution, with different algorithms depending on the shape parameter.
